title: Choose the visual world for DBBL
question: The roll assigned Halkhata & Alpona. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Halkhata & Alpona
options.lineage: Pohela Boishakh: the merchant's new red ledger (halkhata) and street alpona painted in rice-white
options.thesis: The bank as Bangladesh's honest ledger: every product a petal of one alpona, every proof an entry in a red-bound book.
materials: rice-paste alpona linework on indigo asphalt
red cloth ledger binding with ruled columns
hand-lettered Bangla signboard type (Anek Bangla, width axis)
options.viewport: Indigo field; a radial alpona draws itself from DBBL's mark, its seven petals the seven jobs (save, spend, borrow, send home, pay by phone, business, find ATM); headline left in wide Anek, a marigold Internet Banking action and 16216 always visible.
options.risk: Festival imagery can read seasonal or costume if it decorates instead of structuring; Mangal Shobhajatra masks are left out because their framing is politically contested.

raised.raise: Particle event display: one need held at a time; choosing a petal isolates it and dims the rest.
CRT arcade: palette law; marigold is reserved for the primary action and nothing else.
Bioluminescent wake: motion only where money moves; at rest the page is still.
Lexicon: guide words; the sticky header names the section you are reading, in English or Bangla.

options.label: The DBBL Line
options.lineage: Dhaka Metro Rail (MRT Line 6) wayfinding and transit network maps
options.thesis: DBBL built the country's money rails; the homepage is their network map, with ATMs, Rocket, NexusPay and branches as lines and stations.
options.viewport: A live network diagram across the hero; the headline sits like a platform sign, and each line opens a product family.
options.risk: Network-map metaphors are common in fintech and infrastructure brands; this is the familiar, safe-strong route.

options.label: Nakshi Kantha Atlas
options.lineage: hand-pieced memory quilt, fused with Bengali nakshi kantha running stitch
options.thesis: Every product family is a stitched kantha block; customer life stages pieced into one quilt.
options.viewport: The full quilt visible at once, one block lifted under a bright red stitch with the headline seamed beside it.
options.case: Fuses well and Bangladeshis know kantha by heart; it holds audience identification but loses on clarity, since unequal patches make products harder to scan than petals.
options.risk: Reads handicraft and slow; a bank's trust can soften into nostalgia.

options.label: Particle Event Display
options.thesis: One transaction frozen as an event, its paths curving out through DBBL's rails.
options.viewport: A WebGL cross-section of one payment's journey.
options.case: Fuses poorly: bank customers don't identify with physics, and it explains products less clearly.
options.kept: One event held at a time: select one path, dim the rest.
options.risk: Cold and abstract for a bank that serves everyone.

options.label: CRT Arcade
options.thesis: Banking as a sixteen-colour game screen.
options.viewport: A pixel playfield with score-style balances.
options.case: Gen Z may smile, but it undermines trust and reads gimmick for older customers.
options.kept: Palette law: one colour reserved for one meaning.

options.label: Bioluminescent Wake
options.thesis: Every touch leaves a glowing trail of money moving.
options.viewport: A black field that lights up under the pointer.
options.case: Beautiful but says nothing about DBBL's products and nothing Bangladeshi.
options.kept: Motion only where activity happens; rest is darkness.
options.risk: Low clarity, heavy on mid-range phones.

options.label: Tropicália Collage
options.thesis: Customers cut out and pasted into a painted Dhaka tableau.
options.viewport: One crowded tableau, with navigation between pasted figures.
options.case: Too chaotic for finding a product; collage needs photography this project doesn't have.
options.kept: Scale courage: one oversized element per viewport.
options.risk: Navigation by collage hides the actions.

options.label: Lexicon & Plate
options.thesis: The bank as a reference book: entries, guide words, colour plates.
options.viewport: A dense column of products with guide words at the head.
options.case: Clear for reading but the opposite of the energetic, visual-first brief.
options.kept: Guide words: the header always names where you are.
options.risk: Reads like documentation, not a bank people want to join.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A modern bank homepage the way City Bank and peers ship it, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Full-bleed lifestyle slider with headline and two CTAs, product carousel below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
